label: German unit-linked life insurance
help: Use an existing fully unit-linked policy with one cash payout. Enter the gross surrender value, historical premiums paid, and the insurer’s tax dates.
halfGainHelp: Enter the first eligible date confirmed by the insurer. An empty field uses full-gain treatment.
invalid.contract: Enter a contract date from 2018 onwards.
invalid.eligibility: The insurer-confirmed date requires at least twelve years of contract duration.
invalid.structure: Use an existing paid-up policy with no interim deposits, distributions or withdrawals.
invalid.close: Enter a full surrender or cash maturity date on or after contract opening.
invalid.qualifyingLoss: A loss on a policy qualifying for the half-gain rule needs a separate assessment.
invalid.gain: The qualifying gain exceeds the realized policy gain.
